description: Task 9: CDK changes - add mediaconvert-worker construct, MediaConvert IAM role, PassRole permission, update state machine to 4-stage (pages -> audio -> captions -> video).
steps: Create infra/lib/mediaconvert-worker-construct.ts: Lambda Function using Code.fromAsset('../lambdas/mediaconvert-worker/dist') with handler index.handler, nodejs22.x, 512MB memory, 300s timeout. Pass environment vars: BUCKET_NAME, MEDIACONVERT_ROLE_ARN, MEDIACONVERT_ENDPOINT (optional). Grant S3 read/write. Grant mediaconvert:CreateJob, mediaconvert:GetJob permissions.

Create MediaConvert IAM service role in CDK (either in a new construct or within main-stack): Role with principal mediaconvert.amazonaws.com. Permissions: s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject on the project bucket. This role ARN is passed to the mediaconvert-worker as MEDIACONVERT_ROLE_ARN env var.
Add iam:PassRole permission to the mediaconvert-worker Lambda's execution role, restricted to the MediaConvert service role ARN only.

Update infra/lib/render-state-machine-construct.ts: Remove clip-worker and concat-worker references. Change to 4 stages: pages -> audio -> captions -> video. The video stage invokes mediaconvert-worker Lambda. Update props interface to accept mediaconvertWorkerLambda instead of clipWorkerLambda/concatWorkerLambda. Update the Choice state routing accordingly (remove clips/concat options, add video).

Update infra/src/main-stack.ts: Remove ClipWorkerConstruct and ConcatWorkerConstruct imports and instantiation. Add MediaConvertWorkerConstruct (new). Update RenderStateMachineConstruct props to pass mediaconvertWorkerLambda. Remove clip-worker-construct.ts and concat-worker-construct.ts from infra/lib/.
Verify with: cd infra && npx --yes aws-cdk@2 synth (set CDK_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT and CDK_DEFAULT_REGION env vars)
Commit with message: 'feat: task 9 CDK mediaconvert-worker, IAM role, PassRole, 4-stage state machine'
acceptance_criteria: Generated CloudFormation template includes MediaConvert IAM role with s3:GetObject and s3:PutObject on project bucket
PassRole permission on the Lambda execution role targets only the MediaConvert role ARN
State machine definition has 4 stages: pages, audio, captions, video
No references to clip-worker or concat-worker in infra code
